passages.original: Lect. I.—Beatus Damasus, hujus nominis pri- mus, natione Hispanus, patria Vimaranensis, ex Bracarensi provincia, patre Antonio, secundum Hieronymum in ecclesiastica Historia Liberio, se- cundum vero alios Felici II in pontificatu successit, anno Domini 369, sub Valentiniano et Valente impe- ratoribus. Sedit annis decem et octo, mensibus duobus, diebus decem.
passages.english: Lesson I.—Blessed Damasus, the first of this name, a Spaniard by nation, of Vimaranes (Guimarães) by native place, from the province of Braga, whose father was Antonio, succeeded in the pontificate Liberius according to Jerome in [his] Ecclesiastical History, but according to others Felix II, in the year of the Lord 369, under the emperors Valentinian and Valens. He sat [as pope] eighteen years, two months, ten days.
passages.notes: "Lect." taken as lectio, a liturgical reading. "Vimaranensis" is the adjective for Vimaranes, usually identified with Guimarães in Portugal. The date 369 is as the text gives it.
